::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

This page groups substantive guide changes and reader-facing site improvements by month. Each short record describes one change and links to related content; routine updates do not need a new version number.

A record's date is the date of the change, not a verification date for policies, amounts, or procedures in an article. Early site records were added retrospectively from repository commits; the timeline does not reproduce every commit.

:::

## Recent updates {#recent-updates}

::: {.guide-updates}
:::

## Historical milestones (legacy records) {#historical-milestones}

::: {.contribution authors="editorial"}

The wording and dates of the original manual records are preserved below.

- v0.1 on 2022/8/9: created the project, chose the template, and set up GitHub Actions for automatic online compilation and publication.

- v0.2 on 2022/10/12: completed the \[Must do\] and \[Benefits\] chapters, covering compulsory courses, meeting records, APR, conference funding, office supplies, printing, and sports facilities.

- v0.3 on 2022/11/18: completed most of the \[Good to know\] chapter: marking, invigilation, and lab work as a TA, plus the Symposium, which was moved to the \[Must do\] chapter.

- v0.4 on 2023/03/01: added guides to computer backups, lower back and neck care, student cards, and a directory of useful information.

- v1.0 on 2024/08/12: completed the graduation chapter.

- v1.1 on 2024/10/21: added [How academic research happens](../research/how-research-works.qmd#section.how-research-works) and [Visiting Liverpool](../research/liverpool-visit.qmd#section.UoL_visit).

:::
